frozen_contract.same_source: identical exercised bd57 product bytes and identical rejection predicate/condition

issues.issue: The fake engine forward assigns target.cached_len and target.device_len to TARGET_FINAL. This is a cache-length/scheduler state outcome, not a token-model-only side effect.
issues.impact: A replay can manufacture the target length before the actual Scheduler._forward call, defeating the frozen same-source predicate requirement. The existing 13376 receipt cannot establish SAME under the new contract.
issues.fix: Use a replay whose substitute only returns token outputs and whose cache length/rejection result arises through the exercised real bd57 path; otherwise retain UNREPRODUCED.

issues.issue: Scheduler is allocated with object.__new__ and its required fields are hand-populated; Scheduler.__init__ is not exercised.
issues.impact: The replay omits configuration/initialization predicates that could decide whether D09 snapshotting and hybrid commit occur.
issues.fix: Construct the real Scheduler with the exact pinned D09 configuration, or explicitly classify a _forward-only seam replay as insufficient for same-source conclusion.

exact commit and exercised cache.py/scheduler.py SHA binding
record exact flags/prompts/splits and source of 20160
demonstrate actual rejection predicate and line path, not merely reported return value
both required lengths from compliant real path; otherwise stop UNREPRODUCED
